page.layout: One page of text. Title ornament at the top, then the title block, the heading "IN PRÆFATIONEM.", the article heading, and running text below. No marginal notes, no text below the main text.

main_text.head: IN ROBERTI BELLARMINI CONTROVERSIAM VI: QVÆ ET TERTIA EST tomi 2. de Ecclesia quę est in Purgatorio.
IN PRÆFATIONEM.
I. ART. I.
main_text.p: De ea disputandum est, quæ degit infrà terram:] dicendum fuerat, quæ dicitur, aut quę putatur degere infra terram. Nos Ecclesiam proprie dictam negamus infrà terram esse. Eiusdem generis sunt quæ sequuntur proximè, Fideles iam defunctos, necdum beatos, & corpore & animo esse infra terram, diuersis in locis, Negamus.
main_text.head: Liber prior, de Purgatorio:
IN CAPVT I.
main_text.p: 1. Art.2. Multi iusti affliguntur, non vt purgentur, sed vt exerceantur & probentur. Hæc duo non sunt

page.notes: The drop capital D in "De" is a woodcut initial and is joined to the word. The mark ":]" after "terram:" is doubtful and is marked [?]. The signature "Aa j" is partly worn and is marked [?]. Faint show-through of the reverse page is present and was left out. The ornament at the right edge of "purgentur," and the mark after "sunt" are printer's marks and were not transcribed.
